statement: A first word exceeding the bound MUST be hard-cut -- the only permitted mid-word cut.
note: The FIRST word alone is longer than 60 characters, so the word-boundary rule of REC-060 has no boundary to land on. This is the one case where a mid-word cut is permitted: a slug must be bounded. An implementation that returns the un-truncated first word, or falls back to the empty string, is non-conformant.
